title: fix(app-shell): after a datasource sync, link each new object and name the steps left; the form labels a label-less field like the list

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCfxiGcVNzpV4KPtj6nbC3x)_

Part of #30328

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置 → 数据源「同步对象」成功后，对话框不再关掉只弹一句「已同步 1 个对象」，而是停在结果页：列出新建的对象并给出可点开的链接，说明还剩两步（加入某个应用、在权限集中授予访问）。另外，没有 label 的字段在新建/编辑表单里改用和列表相同的可读名（`part_no` → `Part no`），不再直接显示字段名。
- 为什么改：同步完的对象不在任何应用里、普通成员没有权限，管理员只能手敲地址才能找到它，也不知道还差什么；同一个字段列表叫 `Part name`、表单叫 `part_name`。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端：数据源页面、表单的 label 回退规则、studio 词条新增 4 行（en/zh）。写了 label 的字段不受影响；同步一个也没建成时行为和原来一样。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`（`SyncResultNote`、`runSync` 结尾）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` 的 `fieldNameLabel`、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` 的 `engine.datasource.syncNextStep*`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.syncNextSteps-30328.test.tsx packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.fieldNameLabel-30328.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30328, the **domain:ui half only**. The server half (the object draft's field labels, and which package a synced object lives in and whether it exports under ADR-0146) is #30469, so this PR does not close the card.

- **The sync result.** When a Sync run creates at least one object, the dialog stays open on the result instead of closing behind a success toast (`SyncResultNote`): the count line, one link per created object (label, with the name beside it when they differ), and a box naming the two steps left before people can use it: add it to an app, and grant access in a permission set. The link opens the object under the app the page is in (`/apps/SEGMENT/OBJECT`, read from the current path; Setup when the path names no app). It is a router `Link`, so the console navigates in place. `SyncResultNote` is the only part of the page that reads the router, and it mounts only after a sync, so the page's other test files, which render without a router, are unchanged. A run that creates nothing closes the dialog as before; refused tables still go to the error toast either way. The dialog's footer offers Close on the result.
- **Form labels (item ②).** A declared field with no `label` was drawn in the form under its raw name (`ObjectForm` generated fields and `fromObjectSchema` both used `field.label || fieldName`), while the list draws it under the name with the first letter capitalised and underscores as spaces (`objectGridGenerateColumns` in plugin-grid, the same expression in four places there). `fieldNameLabel()` in `sectionFields.ts` is that rule, and both form paths now use it as the fallback passed to `fieldLabel()`, so a translation still wins and an authored label is unchanged. `FieldSchema.label` is optional in the spec, so this is the renderer's rule for valid metadata, not a tolerance for invalid metadata. plugin-grid is unchanged and no `@object-ui/core` export is added (claim amendment 6658567034).
- **i18n (the widening).** Four new `studio` namespace rows, en and zh: `engine.datasource.syncNextStepsOne`, `engine.datasource.syncNextSteps`, `engine.datasource.syncNextStepApp`, `engine.datasource.syncNextStepAccess`. The count line reuses `engine.datasource.syncedOne` / `synced` and the button reuses `engine.close`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30328-datasource-sync-next-steps.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-53q18n`, not `claude/issue-30328-*`; the card is #30328.

## Tests

- `DatasourceResourcePage.syncNextSteps-30328.test.tsx` (new, 4 cases), under a `MemoryRouter` at `/apps/setup/metadata/datasource`; expectations are read from Studio's table, never retyped:
  - one object: the dialog stays on the result, the link reads `Spare Parts (spare_parts)` with `href` `/apps/setup/spare_parts`, both steps are listed, no success toast, and clicking the link moves the router there;
  - two created and one refused: both created objects are linked, the refusal reaches the error toast once, and the footer Close closes the dialog;
  - none created: the dialog closes, nothing is saved, the refusal is toasted;
  - zh: the result and both steps read in Chinese (guarded as real Han rows).
- `ObjectForm.fieldNameLabel-30328.test.tsx` (new, 3 cases): the rule (`part_no` → `Part no`); the generated form draws `Part no` / `Unit price` and never the raw names; `fromObjectSchema` draws `Part no`; CONTROL: an authored label (`Supplier`) stays in both paths.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order said the copy goes into 10 locales. The `studio` namespace ships `en` and `zh` only, by the ruling recorded in its header (every other language falls back to `en`, no invented translations), so the four rows are en and zh like every other `engine.datasource.*` row.
- Out of scope here: the zh form title `新建Spare Parts` (#30126 item 1), the object draft's labels and the synced object's package and export (#30469). Seen on the live rig and routed by the seat to #30334 item 1: on the new-record page of the synced external object, an administrator reads 「您没有创建Spare Parts的权限，字段均为只读。」.
- The step copy says only administrators can read a synced object's records until a permission set grants it. That is the filer's measurement on the card (an ordinary member gets 403); this PR did not re-measure it as a member.

## Verification

Gates and tests ran on `e93daf70` (the gate runner started on `8787d0b7`; `e93daf70`, which only types the new plugin-form test's data source, landed while its first five families, the changeset and ADR-0087 checks, were running); the head adds an evidence commit and its removal, the tree is byte-identical (`git diff e93daf70 HEAD` is empty). Base `f273c9fe`.

<details><summary>Live rig and screenshots (zh-CN, 1440 wide)</summary>

`examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port, the console via `vite` in `ui/apps/console` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Chromium, browser locale zh-CN. An external SQLite file with table `spare_parts` (`id`, `part_no`, `part_name`, `unit_price`, `in_stock`, 3 rows), registered as `POST /api/v1/datasources` `parts_db` (label 零件库, `schemaMode: external`), then synced through the dialog.

Item ② measured on the base: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/spare_parts` served the business fields with no label (`{"part_no":{"type":"text"},"part_name":{"type":"text"},...}`); the list headers read `Part name`, `Part no`, `Unit price`, `In stock`; the new-record form labels read `part_no`, `part_name`, `unit_price`, `in_stock`. After: the form reads `Part no`, `Part name`, `Unit price`, `In stock`.

Before (page restored to the base for the shot): the dialog closes and the toast reads 「已从 parts_db 同步 1 个对象。」.

![before sync](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/f526862871a2e7d44baa84b2a8c4a29f5c40a9a2/evidence/30328/before-1-sync-toast-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

After: the dialog shows 「已从 parts_db 同步 1 个对象。」, the link `Spare Parts (spare_parts)` (`href` `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/spare_parts`), and 「还剩两步，其他人才能使用它：」 with both steps. Clicking the link opened the object's list (3 records).

![after sync](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/f526862871a2e7d44baa84b2a8c4a29f5c40a9a2/evidence/30328/after-1-sync-result-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
